notices.body_en: Version 0.33.5.44 is out now for Android, Windows and iOS. The iOS build is an unsigned package: sign and install it yourself with TrollStore, SideStore or AltStore. The website has been redesigned, and its download page now includes an iOS installation guide with the steps and renewal method for all four sideloading routes.
notices.body_zh: 新版本 0.33.5.44 已经发布，安卓、Windows 和 iOS 三个平台都可以下载。iOS 版是未签名安装包，需要用 TrollStore、SideStore 或 AltStore 自行签名后安装。官网已经完成改版，软件下载页新增了 iOS 安装教程，四条侧载路线的步骤和续签方法都写在里面。
notices.title_zh: 0.33.5.44 已发布：安卓 / Windows / iOS 三平台
